head: 2be0ff59f9f08436d22e4cd4b27de7ad4629aaa2
summary: The fix-round job fires on any 'changes requested' pull_request_review without checking the reviewer's repository association, so on this public repo any GitHub user with mere read access (not a collaborator) can submit a review whose free-text body is fed to a privileged, non-interactive Claude Code run (contents/pull-requests/issues/checks/actions: write, ANTHROPIC_API_KEY and CLAUDE_CODE_OAUTH_TOKEN in env) against an existing pull request - a prompt-injection channel that the label-gated routes in the same file don't share, since applying a label already requires GitHub triage/write permission.
